parameters.query: WITH resolved AS (UPDATE helpdesk.review_tasks SET status='resolved',resolution=$2,resolved_by=$3,resolved_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE review_task_id=$1::uuid AND status IN ('open','claimed') RETURNING ticket_id), updated_ticket AS (UPDATE helpdesk.tickets t SET status=CASE WHEN $2='route' THEN 'routed' ELSE 'failed' END,assigned_queue=CASE WHEN $2='route' THEN $4 ELSE 'manual_review' END,needs_human_review=false,updated_at=now() FROM resolved r WHERE t.ticket_id=r.ticket_id RETURNING t.ticket_id,t.correlation_id), event AS (INSERT INTO helpdesk.ticket_events (ticket_id,event_type,actor,correlation_id,metadata) SELECT ticket_id,CASE WHEN $2='route' THEN 'human_review_routed' ELSE 'human_review_rejected' END,$3,correlation_id,jsonb_build_object('assigned_queue',$4) FROM updated_ticket) SELECT ticket_id,correlation_id FROM updated_ticket;
